description: This file defines the NoteRequest class used as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for creating or updating notes in the backend, including validation constraints.

classes.name: NoteRequest
classes.description: A DTO class representing the payload for creating or updating a note, including validation constraints for title and content.

methods.description: Constructor to initialize NoteRequest with title and content.

methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent()
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.description: Sets the content of the note.
